findings.title: Live publication failures delete the only recording
findings.claim: A retryable phone desk-write failure causes the live wrist relay to delete its unacknowledged Work recording.
findings.evidence: The phone sends workPublicationFailure (.workDeskWriteFailed, code 78) at AppleSpeechRelayCoordinator.swift:426. AppError.swift:1179 classifies it as retryable and :1443 reconstructs it correctly. However, runRelay only defers sttProviderUnreachable and sttKeyUnreadable before reaching 'guard AppleRelayPendingQueue.shared.claimEntry(requestID: requestID) != nil'. AppleRelayPendingQueue.swift:256 deletes the claimed audio file.
findings.scenario: Record a Work note with the phone reachable; its phase-1 store write fails before publication. Code 78 arrives while the live continuation exists. The wrist claims and deletes the clip, while the phone's defer also removes its temporary file. No durable recording remains.
findings.fix: Before the live failure claims, defer retryable Work errors and retain the queue entry; preserve Chat's existing behavior.
findings.refutationAttempt: The deferred queue correctly checks isRetryable, but handleReply resumes an existing continuation directly, bypassing that protection. The phone's publication test checks the error classification, not this live consumer.

findings.title: Terminal replies from older phones destroy Work captures
findings.claim: Work entries still inherit Chat's destructive terminal-error handling despite having no durable acknowledgement.
findings.evidence: reconcile checks only 'Self.leavesEntryQueued(after: error)' before claiming; that predicate is '(error as? AppError)?.isRetryable ?? false' at :505. drain likewise claims terminal errors at :462. Neither failure path checks entry.destination. The live model-not-installed branch also claims at WatchRecordingService.swift:1818.
findings.scenario: A new wrist queues a Work recording while disconnected. An older phone later receives it with no usable speech model and returns code 18. That phone has no Work publication branch and deletes its temporary audio. Reconciliation treats code 18 as terminal and deletes the wrist's sole remaining copy, without saving words or receiving result.work.
findings.fix: Make failure retention destination-specific across live, reconciliation and drain paths: retain unacknowledged Work recordings until durable settlement or explicit discard, while preserving Chat's terminal-error behavior.
findings.refutationAttempt: A current phone often publishes audio before transcription fails, but the supported older-phone scenario has no such publication. The words-only fallback cannot rescue an error reply because it runs exclusively on success.

findings.title: A late acknowledgement marks a different capture as saved
findings.claim: Deferred settlement updates the visible Work outcome without correlating it to the capture being displayed.
findings.evidence: AppleRelayPendingQueue.swift:653 calls 'noteWorkCaptureSettled(settlement)' without the entry's requestID. That method unconditionally assigns 'workCaptureOutcome = .saved' or '.savedWordsOnly'. WatchWorkCaptureView.swift:61 renders this shared outcome; its requestID is used only for logging.
findings.scenario: Record Work captures A and B while delivery is unavailable; both time out and remain queued. Leave B's deferred-outcome screen open. A's delayed acknowledgement arrives while B remains undelivered. The service is idle, so reconciliation proceeds and B's screen changes to 'Saved to Work.'
findings.fix: Associate the displayed outcome with its relay requestID and update it only for a matching settlement; retain notifications for other captures.
findings.refutationAttempt: The busy guard blocks settlement during recording or uploading, but deferred Work captures explicitly return to idle. Distinct navigation nonces do not help because the view reads an unscoped singleton outcome.
